Every shadow is just waiting... to come alive.
All you need is a lamp, a wall, and your own two hands.
Make a rabbit, the way you did when you were small.
A rabbit. A wolf. A duck.
Bring your hand toward the light, and it grows. Pull it away, and it shrinks.
Let the wolf howl, and the crows fly off the fence.
Open and close the beak, and the duck paddles you across.
Eight little scenes. One paper theatre. And a sleepy moon to wake.
